entry.title: Updated: dsh-wechat-mp
entry.summary: Turns markdown into a WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) draft: inlines every CSS rule onto its element because the editor discards `<style>` blocks and class names, uploads each local image through WeChat's own endpoint so it is not filtered out, and creates the draft; it never broadcasts. Exact install spec: dsh-wechat-mp. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
